cruxes.question: Should agency partners start now, before any install is proven?

sides.position: Yes: partners own lists and trust
No: nobody sells an unproven offer

cruxes.question: Do three installs plus selling fit in about 43 hours?

sides.position: Only if each install stays under 15 hours

cruxes.question: Do warm yeses from friends prove real demand?

sides.position: Post each install so strangers buy next

note: All six back direct outreach, so the Chair is making the partner channel argue its case at full strength.
